svg.title: Architecture diagram. Untrusted input such as prompts, files, web pages and MCP servers passes through zn-gate on your machine before it reaches the agent. zn-gate checks the prompt, the tool call and the tool result, using a local rules engine, a PII and secret scrubber, an encrypted vault and a hash-chained audit log. Only with ZN_CLOUD=1 and ZN_API_KEY set, prompts with detected secrets removed go to the optional Galvanize 2 classifier at api.usezn.com.
